structured_assessments.method: Header22lines and ending18lines inspected; full blob identity verified, body not manually read.

findings: Only implementation is a WordPress/Jetpack save_post hashtag appender; no filesystem enumeration, file/image comparison or duplicate library. README and WordPress readme fully read; external screenshot URL not fetched or treated as tracked image.

Case-insensitive substring stripos is used instead of hashtag token equality: existing #foobar suppresses #foo. ASCII space removal maps distinct labels to same hashtag; strlen measures bytes rather than Unicode/social-message character units. Candidate length guard uses <= and omits separator in sum, and breaks on first too-long candidate rather than trying later shorter tags. Source inspection only; PHP unavailable, no runtime test/install or WordPress mutation performed.

save_post callback accepts first argument as ignorePostStatus boolean, whereas WordPress hook convention supplies post ID; nonzero ID can bypass intended published-status guard. Host API behavior not executed. Plugin writes _wpas_mess metadata, unrelated to duplicate files. No code adopted.
license.txt header and ending inspected: GPLv2; body not manually read. Plugin header says GPLv2 or later. License retained as structured assessment, not whole-file credit.
